source.primary: KSE Institute Leave Russia / SelfSanctions database (RAS filings from Russian FTS/EGRUL), as published in KSE digests and B4Ukraine reports

B4U22.title: The Business of Staying: a closer look at multinational revenues and taxes in Russia in 2022 (B4Ukraine/KSE Institute)
B4U22.scope: 2022 data; excludes companies that had exited by mid-2023; profit tax excludes rebates; p.8 chart

B4U23.title: Corporate Enablers of Russia's War in Ukraine: multinational taxes and revenue in Russia in 2023 (B4Ukraine/KSE/Squeezing Putin)
B4U23.scope: 2021 and 2023 data; excludes companies that have exited; profit tax excludes rebates; pp.16-17 and 25 charts (Source: KSE)

B4U24.title: Corporate Complicity: How Global Firms Bankrolled Russia's War Chest in 2024 (B4Ukraine/KSE/Squeezing Putin)
B4U24.scope: 2024 profit tax by country of HQ (top-10 overall + top-10 EU), pp.12-14

KSE80.title: KSE Institute, 80th regular digest on impact of foreign companies' exit on RF economy
KSE80.scope: aggregate tables 2021-2025 by KSE status (1,646 groups with RF financials); 2025 is preliminary

KSE_NEWS_2024_09.title: KSE: Revenue of foreign companies in Russia fell by $125 billion, but profits remained stable

LR_SITE.title: leave-russia.org country filter counts (all entries) and companies-that-exited page counts
LR_SITE.scope: all database entries incl. firms without Russian legal entities

ECB.title: ECB reference rate USD per EUR, annual average (EXR A.USD.EUR.SP00.A)

source.access_notes: leave-russia.org filtered/paged views return HTTP 500; Power BI analytics dashboards return 403; SSRN and ResearchGate PDFs return 403 (Cloudflare). KSE full per-country tables (SSRN 5375884 etc.) therefore not obtained; per-country figures come from B4Ukraine reports built on KSE data. Paid API exists (Patreon) - not used.

fx.method: KSE publishes in USD (KSE converts RUB->USD itself; rate not stated in sources reviewed). Converted USD->EUR with ECB annual average reference rate (USD per EUR).

certainty: B = KSE estimates from Russian RAS filings; 2024 partly extrapolated by KSE for ~50 of top-100 firms that stopped publishing

USA.counts_basis: B4U24 report (KSE data, mid-2025): staying/leaving/exited of companies with ties to Russia at start of 2022
USA.taxes_type: corporate profit tax only (excl. rebates); not total tax

totals.basis: KSE Institute, 1,646 foreign groups with Russian (RAS) financials; all statuses incl. exited (digest 80, 2026-07-10). 2025 preliminary.
totals.total_taxes_definition: All taxes: profit tax, VAT, exit taxes, payroll tax, property tax, excise and customs duties (B4U23 footnote 1). 2024 = "at least $20bn" (B4U24). 2022: B4Ukraine Feb-2024 report says 2022-23 "may amount to $20 billion annually" (estimate, not recorded as a number). Cumulative 2022-2024: >$60bn (B4U24).

notes_per_year.2021: profit $18.4bn and profit tax $5.4bn from KSE news 2024-09-26 (1,510 companies basis); revenue and total taxes from digest 80

2022_excl_exited.src: B4U22 (note: inconsistent with its own DEU+FRA+NLD=630)

notes: taxes_paid_in_russia per country = corporate PROFIT TAX only, excluding rebates and excluding exited companies (B4U22/B4U23). Total taxes (VAT, payroll, excise, customs etc.) are only available as all-company totals.
Per-country net profit is not published in any accessible source -> null.
Country data cover only the countries shown in B4U charts (top 20-22 by revenue/tax); others null.
Yale CELI list not used for numbers (no financials; letter grades), B4Ukraine figures are KSE data.
Company counts: per-country stay/leave split only published for USA and DEU (B4U24); others have % staying as reported and site entry totals/exited counts.
2025 figures (preliminary) available only as all-company totals (KSE digest 80).
